test: does cross-line transfer keep rising at 908 cell lines?
log: LOOP 267 -- THE TRANSFER CURVE AT 908 CELL LINES
Loop 265 measured +0.00094 per added line over n = 2 to 11 and extrapolated ~61
lines to close the gap. Its own R7 said a curve flat from 2 to 11 could still
rise at 50, and nothing on hand could test it. Score2 has 908 -- an order of
magnitude past the extrapolation, so this can FALSIFY the slope, not just extend it.
STRUCTURAL DIFFERENCE, stated first: Score2 fitness is ONE SCALAR per (gene, line),
so there is no per-line operator and loop 266's 'own operator' arm does not exist.
By loop 260's geometry a model using only the held-out line is confined to its
line mean, which the baseline already holds. So this is borrow against BASELINE.
CRISPRcleanR: 908 cell lines x 15,565 genes (finite everywhere)
T1 IS THE INTERACTION SUBSTANTIAL?
variance of fitness: gene main 72.6%, line main 0.0%, interaction 27.4%
LINCS was 27.6% gene / 3.8% line / 68.7% interaction
T1 PASS -- 27.4% of fitness variance is gene x line interaction, so there is something here to transfer
T2 DOES LOOP 260'S GEOMETRY REPLICATE?
best gene-only model of the residual: 0.000000   line-only: 0.000000
loop 260 measured 0.000270 and 0.000017 on LINCS shRNA -- a different assay
T2 PASS -- 0.0000% and 0.0000%; double-centring pins one-way models at zero on CRISPR fitness exactly as it did on shRNA

T5 VOID -- T4 did not pass, so there is nothing here to test
T6 DOES IT REPLICATE ACROSS PROCESSING PIPELINES?
CERES: 908 lines x 15,565 genes -- the SAME screens, a
different copy-number-bias pipeline. Anything that appears in one and not the
other is the pipeline rather than the biology.

CERES rise +0.0173 against CRISPRcleanR's +0.0188   difference 0.0015
CERES saturates at n = 600 against CRISPRcleanR's 600
T6 PASS -- the two pipelines agree to 0.0015; this is the first replication in the arc that needed no new data
T7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
Fitness is a SCALAR per (gene, line). There is no response profile and no
operator, so nothing here speaks to loop 262's off-diagonal finding, which was
about coupling BETWEEN readout genes and needs a multivariate readout.
The measured genes are a RANDOM subset, as in loop 266. A chosen panel would
almost certainly need fewer genes, and nothing here says which to choose.
908 lines is many, but they are all CANCER cell lines from 27 types. Saturation
here is saturation within that population, not across human cell states.
CRISPR knockout is not shRNA knockdown, and a fitness readout is not expression.
Agreement with LINCS would be a real cross-assay result; disagreement would not
by itself refute either.
Everything is on the double-centred residual, so by loop 260 and T2 any arm
constant across lines is pinned near zero however expressive it is.
